blocks.text: Mukhtalif kimiyai reactions ki raftarein (rates) bohat mukhtalif hoti hain: NaCl ka AgNO3 se reaction bohat tez hai, ester ka hydrolysis darmiyani raftar se chalta hai, aur lohe ka zang lagna sust hai. Dhamaka (explosion) ek tez reaction hai jo second ke hisse mein ho jata hai, jabke zang lagne mein din ya mahine lag sakte hain. Reaction kinetics kimiyai reactions ki raftaron ka mutala hai, jis mein raftarein, orders aur mechanisms napne ke tajurbati tareeqe shamil hain. Sanat mein raftarein aur un par qaboo aksar aham hain, jahan yeh tai kar sakti hain ke koi reaction iqtisadi taur par istemal ho sakti hai ya nahi, to woh halaat dhoondna aham hai jin mein reaction sab se iqtisadi tarah chale.

Collision theory samjhati hai ke reactions kaise hoti hain. Kimiyai reaction hone ke liye reactants ke zarraat, atoms, ions ya molecules, ko yaksan (homogeneous) mixture bana kar ek doosre se takrana hoga. Yeh takrao (collisions) takrane wale zarraat ki energy ke mutabiq moassar ya ghair-moassar ho sakte hain: moassar collisions products dete hain, warna zarraat bas wapas uchhal jate hain. Moassar collisions sirf tab hote hain jab takrane wale zarraat ke paas ek khas miqdar ki energy ho aur woh ek doosre ke paas durust rukh (orientation) se aayein.

blocks.title: Activation energy
blocks.text: React karne wali species ke darmiyan moassar collision ke liye darkar kam se kam energy activation energy kehlati hai. Zyada tar reactions sust hain, jo dikhata hai ke sab collisions barabar moassar nahi.

Yeh amal reaction ke raste ke muqable potential energy ke graph se samjha ja sakta hai. Agar collision moassar ho to alag hone wale molecules kimiyai taur par mukhtalif hote hain; warna wahi molecules wapas uchhalte hain. Reactants curve ki choti tak pohnch kar activated complex banate hain, aur sirf munasib activation energy wale takrane wale molecules pahari charh kar products de sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Reaction hone ke liye collision frequency aur orientation dono zaroori hain. Is ki daleel dein, aur batayein ke activation energy raftar par kaise asar karti hai.
blocks.explanation: Molecules react karne se pehle milne chahiyein, to zyada collisions zyada reaction ke mauqe dete hain; magar collision sirf tab moassar hai jab molecules durust rukh se aur kam se kam activation energy ke saath takrayein, warna woh be-tabdeel alag ho jate hain. Activation energy jitni zyada, utna chhota hissa collisions ka rukawat paar kar sakta hai aur reaction utni sust; kam activation energy reaction ko tez banati hai.

items: Reaction kinetics raftaron (tez: NaCl + AgNO3, dhamake; darmiyani: ester hydrolysis; sust: zang), orders aur mechanisms ka mutala hai, jo tai karte hain ke sanati reaction iqtisadi hai ya nahi.
Collision theory: reactant zarraat kaafi energy (kam se kam activation energy) aur durust rukh se takrayein; moassar collisions energy curve ki choti par activated complex se guzarte hain.
